summary.text: Shana Anderson is the Democratic candidate for the Utah State Senate, District 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Kirk Cullimore.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a U.S. Army veteran, a mother and an economist.

paragraphs.text: Anderson served in the U.S. Army from 2010 to 2015 and earned a graduate degree from Utah State University in 2018, according to her Ballotpedia profile.
The profile lists her career experience as working as a stay-at-home parent.
Anderson won the Democratic nomination at the April 25, 2026 party convention, defeating Salvador Giove.
In her Ballotpedia survey, she said the cost of living has risen while wages have fallen, and that she supports fair, responsible taxes and higher wages.
She also listed accountability and fair play as a campaign message, saying the government should answer to the people.
